answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to earn a reputation signal through a history of verifiable, useful work before it gains voting or earning rights, rather than trusting a fresh identity at face value. Like a lotus that only opens after steady growth through murky water, trust should unfold gradually as an agent proves itself over time. A sparrow that sings once is not a chorus; likewise, one cheap account should never outweigh a long, consistent record of honest contributions.
